description: Cursor-Governance binding to the canonical memory control plane (l9-graphiti-memory). Read by ops/memory/runtime_binding.py, which proves the exact package, interpreter, and console script before any lifecycle call. This is a Cursor-owned statement of what Cursor expects to run; it grants nothing and resolves no provider. Production binding is an immutable release artifact locked in uv.lock; until MEMORY_TARGET_VERSION is cut (campaign stage M2), integration binds the exact git SHA below and reports binding_status accordingly.

source.ref_note: PR M1 head (Quantum-L9/l9-graphiti-memory#56): CLI close, capabilities receipt, SDK parity, continuation candidate contract (ADR-082), validation-evidence re-pin. Replace with the MEMORY_TARGET_VERSION release tag at M2 and lock it in uv.lock; a git ref is an integration binding, never a production one.

binding_policy.production: exact release artifact locked in uv.lock; runtime_mode=pinned_environment
binding_policy.integration: exact git SHA above, installed as a built wheel into the governance environment; runtime_mode=pinned_environment
binding_policy.development: L9_MEMORY_DEV_CHECKOUT=<path to a l9-graphiti-memory checkout with .venv>; runtime_mode=development_checkout, never silent
forbidden: whatever l9-memory is first on PATH
an adjacent checkout discovered by directory scanning
pip install -e of a sibling checkout without the development opt-in
